The scheduler enforces these cadences using a deterministic function that varies by tier. Items fetched are stored with provenance metadata, ensuring traceability. The beat-desk pipeline classifies signals into semantic categories using deterministic rules and resolves entities to canonical identifiers. The tipster leaderboard computes effective trust weights using an exponential moving average of accuracy scores, which are updated after each outcome. These systems form a closed-loop architecture where trust is dynamically adjusted based on performance and integrity checks.
